Class ReportsDAO.XReportData

java.lang.Object
com.sharetea.dao.ReportsDAO.XReportData
Enclosing class:
ReportsDAO
public static class ReportsDAO.XReportData extends Object
Everything shown on the X-Report for one day: sales totals, sales by hour and sales by payment method. The X-Report only reads data; it does not reset any totals.
